meaning.long_meaning: Aruna corresponds to the Sanskrit form अरुणा. Its core lexical sense is reddish, ruddy; the dawn; the sun's charioteer. अरुणा (aruṇā) is the feminine form of अरुण, reddish or ruddy. The source gloss 'Goddess of Dawn' is a derived sense.
